# KITTY CORP — Official Company and Technical Context

Canonical website: https://thekittycorp.com
Country of origin: India
Commercial Digital Solutions Studio: https://demo.thekittycorp.com
Company profile: https://thekittycorp.com/company
Research: https://thekittycorp.com/research
Projects: https://thekittycorp.com/projects
Sitemap: https://thekittycorp.com/sitemap.xml

## Company identity

KITTY CORP is an early-stage Indian technology company focused on Physical-World Intelligence: systems that connect artificial intelligence, software, sensors and machines to real physical environments.

The company has two complementary areas:
1. **Intelligence & Robotics** — research and development in AI robotics, agricultural field systems, clean-energy intelligence and embodied perception/control.
2. **Digital Solutions Studio** — commercial websites, applications, custom software, AI workflows and integrations for clients.

## Research initiatives

### KITTY AgriYaan
An autonomous agricultural rover initiative exploring crop monitoring, field sensing, terrain mobility and edge computer vision for practical agricultural work. Current development stage: simulation and kinematics. No field-deployment claim is made.

Official page: https://thekittycorp.com/agriyaan

### KITTY UrjaYaan
An intelligent solar and clean-energy initiative focused on solar monitoring, energy utilisation, predictive telemetry and optimisation of clean-energy infrastructure. Current development includes algorithmic modelling.

Official page: https://thekittycorp.com/urjayaan

### KITTY AI
A vision-and-control software stack under active development. The intended architecture connects spatial perception, multi-sensor inputs, edge inference and robotic actuator control.

Official page: https://thekittycorp.com/research

### KITTY Buddy
An exploratory physical AI companion concept centred on voice interaction and tangible human-machine interaction. It is at concept-exploration stage.

Official page: https://thekittycorp.com/buddy

## Digital Solutions Studio

The Studio delivers client-facing digital engineering:
- Business websites and web development
- Web and Android applications
- Custom software and internal tools
- AI agents and workflow automation
- API and business-system integrations

The Studio is a commercial activity intended to generate client revenue and support independent R&D. Demo platform: https://demo.thekittycorp.com

## Revenue model

KITTY CORP generates commercial revenue through scoped client projects in its Digital Solutions Studio, including website development, applications, custom software, AI automation and integrations. This is distinct from research initiatives.

## Technical approach

KITTY CORP distinguishes concepts, simulations, active development and validated hardware. Public claims should reflect the actual stage of each initiative; no research concept should be described as a field-tested or commercially deployed system without evidence.
